agent.problem: The name Phoenix has not appeared in any earlier card, and nothing in the setup lets the baker infer it. The blank can be filled only by guessing an unseen name rather than reasoning out the meaning.

rule.text: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.

agent.problem: The wrong answer "They still hope to reach Phoenix" is not false throughout the passage. In Acts 27:12, the majority decides to sail on in the hope of reaching Phoenix; the answer becomes false only when they abandon all hope in verse 20.

rule.text: Each wrong answer must be false anywhere in the passage, not just at that moment.
